name: Water-Washable
verdict: Strip test, centre 14.0 s (Anycubic factory value, bars 5.6-22.4 s). Thickness by caliper: #1 5.6 s 0.11 · #2 7.7 s 0.19 · #3 9.8 s 0.24 · #4 11.9 s 0.26 · #5 14.0 s 0.29 · #6 16.1 s 0.33 · #7 18.9 s 0.31 · #8 22.4 s 0.35 mm (still growing at #8). The bars lay flat at first and all of them curled while drying - possibly from the water wash (not checked); curl does not separate the bars. Holes look the same on every bar and detail is good throughout. Picked #3, 9.8 s.
about: Anycubic's water-wash standard resin. It cleans in plain water instead of alcohol, which is why it gets used for quick parts.
take: The published numbers print, but they were set by hand before the current method existed. A full re-run is queued.
